_comment: Ellenbrook, added 17 Sep 2026, to fill /explore/perth/spa/ellenbrook/
and the Ellenbrook area page behind it, which held four listings.
HONEST NOTE ON THE SPA PAGE. Ellenbrook does not have many spa &
recovery businesses. There is no float tank, no cold plunge and no
dedicated sauna studio with a website. Two of the seven below reach
the spa shelf on their own merits -- The Live Lightly Centre's
infrared sauna and Ardor Organics' scalp spa -- and a third comes
from the separate edit to Ellenbrook Life Balance, which has a
Sunlighten cabin and was never tagged for it. That takes the page
from one listing to four. Padding it further would mean filing
beauty salons and gyms as recovery, which is the kind of stretch the
category floors exist to stop.
Every business was checked on its own website today. Deliberately
absent: Dream Float on Mornington Parkway, which is the best
category fit in the suburb (float therapy and sauna) but has no site
of its own and takes phone bookings only; Tara Yoga on Comserv Loop,
whose domain no longer resolves -- the same dead-site rule that
removed Whole Me Remedial Massage from the Pemberton set; Love Me
Knots, Rejuvenate Mind&Body and Heavenly Touch, all Facebook-only;
Bello Maison, which is cosmetic injectables rather than wellness;
and the chain gyms with a sauna in the change rooms.
No price bands. None of the seven publishes a session price on its
own site, and the directory does not guess at one. Empower's two
introductory offers are quoted in its excerpt because they are
published figures, but an intro offer is not a session price.
Nothing here repeats anybody's health claims. Ellenbrook Life
Balance's own sauna page talks about detoxification and burning 600
calories; the directory says it has an infrared sauna and stops.

listings.name: The Live Lightly Centre
listings.excerpt: Tracey Walker's naturopathic rooms on Ellen Stirling Parade, working from a health science degree with herbal tinctures made up to order and practitioner-only supplements dispensed in the consultation rather than sold off a shelf. Gluten-free and dairy-free eating plans are part of the work. There is an infrared sauna on site, which can be booked on its own or given as a voucher, and the centre is small enough that you see the same practitioner each visit.

listings.name: Ardor Organics
listings.excerpt: A low-tox hair salon on Main Street that has built a scalp spa into the menu. Alongside organic colour and curl-by-curl cutting — which comes with a one-to-one session on how to keep it at home — there are head spa rituals that cleanse, treat and work the scalp rather than just condition the ends. Refillable haircare in glass bottles. Appointment only, closed Sunday and Monday, and open until 8pm on Thursday for people who finish work late.
services: Scalp spa rituals and head spa treatments
Curly cutting with a one-to-one curl session

listings.name: Eden Massage, Waxing & Beauty
listings.excerpt: A massage and beauty room across the road from Ellenbrook Central, next to the pizza shop, open seven days and happy to take a walk-in when there is a gap. Remedial massage with HICAPS at the counter, so a health fund rebate is claimed before you leave, plus cupping and reflexology, and a beauty side doing waxing, brows and facials. Two tables in the one room for couples who want to book together. Sixteen years in the trade and free street parking out front.
services: Remedial massage with on-the-spot HICAPS claiming

listings.name: Ellenbrook Chiropractic & Wellness Centre
listings.address: Ground Floor, 12 Main Street, Ellenbrook WA 6069
listings.excerpt: A Main Street practice open since 2001, with six chiropractors and remedial massage therapists working out of the same rooms — spinal adjustment, cold laser, custom foot orthotics and exercise programmes on one side of the corridor and the massage table on the other. Weekdays to 6pm, Thursday to 6.30, and Saturday mornings until 11, which makes it one of the few places in the suburb open before the shops.

listings.name: Bare Skin and Beauty Ellenbrook
listings.excerpt: A skin clinic inside Ellenbrook Central, and the Ellenbrook half of a two-room business with a sister clinic at Whitfords. The menu leans clinical rather than pampering — hydrodermabrasion, LED, skin needling, chemical peels, enzyme facials and IPL, across Medik8, O'Cosmedics and Dermaviduals — with waxing, brows, lashes, spray tanning and teeth whitening alongside. It traded as Oxaalis Medispa until the rebrand, so older listings still use that name. Free parking outside.

listings.name: Ellenbrook Pilates
listings.excerpt: The suburb's first reformer studio, run from the same building as Ellenbrook Physiotherapy and programmed by the physiotherapists there. Small-group reformer sits alongside yoga, barre, powerband, strength circuits and mobilise-and-release classes, with a fitted gym floor in the same space, so a week can mix a reformer class with a gym session without a second membership. Classes are booked online and kept small.

listings.name: Empower Pilates Studio Ellenbrook
listings.excerpt: A reformer studio on The Broadway, with a second room in Bellevue, running classes seven days. The timetable splits the reformer two ways — Restore for the slower, stretch-led hour and Sweat for the fast one — with mat and barre alongside, so it is clear before you book which kind of class you are walking into. There is a supervised creche on weekday mornings at $6 a child, showers, and accessible parking. New clients can take two weeks of unlimited classes for $59, or two private introductory reformer sessions for $150. Reception is staffed weekday mornings only; text or email the rest of the time.

listings.name: The Pilates Loft
listings.excerpt: A small matwork practice with no memberships and no minimum — you book the classes that suit the week and come along. Worth checking the address before you drive: the permanent Locke Lane studio is still being fitted out, so classes are running at The Raw Space in Henley Brook in the meantime, with reformer planned for the new room. Email is the way to reach them, since they are usually teaching.
